summary: Frontend-only verification of navy PWA app icons + new mobile 'Add Cravitoo to home screen' install banner. All icon files return with correct pixel dimensions and navy background (#051A47 == RGB(5,26,71)); favicons remain white; maskable variants have visible safe-zone padding (smaller inner mark). Install banner behaves correctly on iOS UA/mobile viewport: hidden before cookie consent, appears within ~3s after 'Got it', shows iOS Share→Add to Home Screen instructions, has NO Install button on iOS, dismiss X writes localStorage cravitoo_pwa_banner_dismissed_v1='1' and banner does NOT reappear on reload. On desktop (1440x900) banner is not rendered at all (sm:hidden + mobile-UA gate). Code review confirms config gates (enabled + expiryDate + isBannerActive) are imported and respected, and standalone display-mode is guarded.

icon_verification.icon-maskable-192.png: 192x192, avg RGB(31,33,67) — lower orange content vs 'any' variant indicates safe-zone padding ✓
icon_verification.manifest_and_index_html: Only local /icons/* references; no external customer-assets URLs ✓

banner_verification.config_gates_present: PWA_BANNER_CONFIG.enabled=true, expiryDate='2026-12-31', isBannerActive() imported and checked first in useEffect; isStandalone() and isMobile() also guard.
banner_verification.android_beforeinstallprompt_path: Verified via code review only (event doesn't fire in Playwright automation) — handler wired to setDeferredPrompt and reveal timer; handleInstall calls prompt() then userChoice.

critical_code_review_comments: Minor: index.html appears to have an unclosed HTML comment before <link rel="manifest"> lines (visible in grep as '<!-- PWA: ... consistently' without a closing '-->' on same line). Worth confirming the block is well-formed so the manifest/apple-touch links are actually active tags and not swallowed by a comment.

Non-blocking: PWA_BANNER_CONFIG.expiryDate uses local device time (`new Date('YYYY-MM-DDT23:59:59')`), so users in later timezones will see the banner slightly longer than users in earlier ones on the expiry day — acceptable for a launch-day kill switch.
context_for_next_testing_agent: iOS banner path was validated live by overriding navigator.userAgent + maxTouchPoints via context.add_init_script before navigation on a 390x844 viewport. To reset banner state between checks, clear localStorage keys 'cravitoo_pwa_banner_dismissed_v1' and 'cravitoo_cookie_consent_v1' and reload. Android install path (beforeinstallprompt) can only be code-reviewed in this env.
